prompt:
I'm a freelance UX/brand consultant operating as Studio Novo. I have a 45-minute discovery call coming up with Paxo Financial Inc. — a fintech startup looking for a complete brand identity refresh. My CRM shows Dana Yuen (Head of Product) is my main contact; we connected via a LinkedIn warm intro on 2025-11-10 and no work has been delivered yet. I need you to do three things for me:

1. Prepare me for this discovery call — I need a proper brief that helps me walk in ready to evaluate whether this is a good fit and understand their situation.

2. After the call (which I'll describe now): Dana attended along with their CEO, Marcus Lim. They confirmed a budget range of $18k–$25k. Marcus is the final decision-maker. Their core problem is that their current brand looks like a generic neo-bank and they're losing deals to better-designed competitors. They need everything delivered before their Series B roadshow, which starts in approximately 10 weeks. We agreed on two next steps: I will send a formal proposal with three scope tiers by this Friday, and Dana will share their existing brand assets (logos, guidelines) by end of next Wednesday. No red flags — strong fit. Next call scheduled for after they review the proposal.

Capture proper meeting notes for this call.

3. Make sure my meeting records are fully up to date — the master meeting index and my running list of outstanding commitments across all meetings should both reflect this new meeting. The existing commitment about sending a revised invoice to a previous client must not be lost.
